encode_text_with_sentencepiece: encode a string into SentencePiece BPE tokens using the SentencepieceBPE encode method
decode_sentencepiece_tokens: decode a space-separated SentencePiece token string back into original text using the decode method
check_beginning_of_word: check if a SentencePiece token is the beginning of a word using the is_beginning_of_word method
configure_sentencepiece_bpe: configure SentencePiece BPE with model path, sampling enabled, and alpha smoothing parameter via SentencepieceConfig
review_sentencepiece_bpe_class: review the SentencepieceBPE class and its encode, decode, and is_beginning_of_word methods
